input.content:
# Checkout conversion drop — Oct 14

## Summary
Checkout conversion fell from **62.8% to 58.3%** on Oct 14 (−4.5 points). The drop is iOS Safari, where completion fell from 62.0% to 41.5%.

## Cause
Release 2026.10.14 moved the wallet button above the card form on mobile. On iOS Safari 17 the wallet sheet then failed to open (INC-884, 14:10–19:40 UTC). Android, desktop and iOS Chrome moved less than one point.

## Evidence
- Funnel by platform and browser from data.csv (funnel.py).
- Release notes and incident INC-884 on the status page.
- The Checker confirmed 3 of 3 claims; the drop starts at 14:10 UTC.

## What we do not know
Whether the 20% off campaign sent at 13:00 UTC changed who reached checkout. It raised traffic; it did not lower completion.

## Next step
Keep the wallet button rollback in place, add a Safari wallet check to the release smoke test, and re-run this workstream tomorrow to confirm recovery.

## Why

## Proof
Funnel by platform from data.csv; release notes; incident page. Three of three claims checked.

## Open question
Did the 13:00 UTC campaign change who reached checkout? Traffic rose; completion did not fall because of it.

## Next
Keep the rollback, add a Safari wallet check to the release smoke test, re-run tomorrow.
